# invariant. With the post-merge main CI run retired, nothing else stands
# between a violated invariant ("SM queue is strictly serialized and
# validates the exact tree being merged", #687) and a red main: this
# workflow fires on EVERY push to main and asserts the pushed tree was
# covered by a successful ci.yml workflow_dispatch run — the SM's
# pre-merge validation. A push without one files/updates one deduplicated
# `sm-guard` issue (event-driven, seconds of runner time — explicitly NOT
# a nightly/polling backstop, per the owner's directive).
#
# The release-bot's chore(release) bump pushes skip the guard (the v* tag
# run gates them: tag_release.sh's enforce-lockfile smoke pre-tag, the
# full quality gate on the tag before publish). SM merge commits and any
# human/admin push are checked — tree identity, so both fast-forward
# (same SHA) and squash/merge-commit (same tree) landings validate.
name: SM merge guard

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  guard:
    name: Validate the pushed tree was SM-validated
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write # the sm-guard alarm issue
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410b181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # The pushed head is the checked-out HEAD; only its tree sha is
          # read — no history, no blobs.
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Assert a dispatched validation covers this tree
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          # head_commit.id is frozen at push time — the checkout can drift
          # to a main that moved in the seconds before the job starts
          # (same lesson as the ci.yml release-tag BUMP_SHA pin, #1178).
          PUSHED_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
          PUSHED_SUBJECT: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}
        run: |
          tree=$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')
          python3 scripts/sm_merge_guard.py \
            --repo "$REPO" \
            --sha "$PUSHED_SHA" \
            --subject "$PUSHED_SUBJECT" \
            --tree "$tree" \
            --alarm-issue

{"content":"# gh-1537 AC5 — the cheap alarm for the SM serialized-validation
# invariant. With the post-merge main CI run retired, nothing else stands
# between a violated invariant ("SM queue is strictly serialized and
# validates the exact tree being merged", #687) and a red main: this
# workflow fires on EVERY push to main and asserts the pushed tree was
# covered by a successful ci.yml workflow_dispatch run — the SM's
# pre-merge validation. A push without one files/updates one deduplicated
# `sm-guard` issue (event-driven, seconds of runner time — explicitly NOT
# a nightly/polling backstop, per the owner's directive).
#
# The release-bot's chore(release) bump pushes skip the guard (the v* tag
# run gates them: tag_release.sh's enforce-lockfile smoke pre-tag, the
# full quality gate on the tag before publish). SM merge commits and any
# human/admin push are checked — tree identity, so both fast-forward
# (same SHA) and squash/merge-commit (same tree) landings validate.
name: SM merge guard

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  guard:
    name: Validate the pushed tree was SM-validated
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write # the sm-guard alarm issue
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410b181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # The pushed head is the checked-out HEAD; only its tree sha is
          # read — no history, no blobs.
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Assert a dispatched validation covers this tree
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          # head_commit.id is frozen at push time — the checkout can drift
          # to a main that moved in the seconds before the job starts
          # (same lesson as the ci.yml release-tag BUMP_SHA pin, #1178).
          PUSHED_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
          PUSHED_SUBJECT: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}
        run: |
          tree=$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')
          python3 scripts/sm_merge_guard.py \
            --repo "$REPO" \
            --sha "$PUSHED_SHA" \
            --subject "$PUSHED_SUBJECT" \
            --tree "$tree" \
            --alarm-issue
","path":".github/workflows/sm-merge-guard.yml"}

  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a

      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0

          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}

    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&

      group: release-main

  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
        run: bash scripts/tag_release.sh

  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a

      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0

          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —

      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke

      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

# Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178

          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}

env:

  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
        run: bash scripts/tag_release.sh

    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    timeout-minutes: 10

      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&

# Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the

          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.

env:

  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
        run: bash scripts/tag_release.sh

  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0

        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push

  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after. gh-1537: extracted from ci.yml (no main-push trigger
  # there anymore) and dropped the needs: quality-gate — the bump commit's
  # full-gate validation moved to the cut v* tag run, which gates
  # publish/binaries (see the file header).
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

# Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the

          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}

env:
          RELEASE_DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.releaseDryRun == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
        run: bash scripts/auto_release.sh

  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
        run: bash scripts/tag_release.sh

  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
        run: bash scripts/tag_release.sh

env:
          RELEASE_DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.releaseDryRun == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
        run: bash scripts/auto_release.sh

  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
        run: bash scripts/tag_release.sh

# Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event

          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.

env:
          RELEASE_DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.releaseDryRun == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
        run: bash scripts/auto_release.sh

  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
        run: bash scripts/tag_release.sh

blocks.text:
env:
          RELEASE_DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.releaseDryRun == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
        run: bash scripts/auto_release.sh

  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the

blocks.text:
env:
          RELEASE_DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.releaseDryRun == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
        run: bash scripts/auto_release.sh

  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and

env:
          RELEASE_DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.releaseDryRun == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
        run: bash scripts/auto_release.sh

  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
        run: bash scripts/tag_release.sh

holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

# Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

# Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke

      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).
