# Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default

          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script

set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

# Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

# Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

{"newText":"## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's

# gh-1537 — the tag-on-bump phase of the release chain, extracted from

#     BEFORE publish/binaries — the bump commit's validation moved there.

# first, next bump after. (#1522 will retire the bump flow itself once

name: Release tag

on:

EOF

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

{"newText":"## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

MockLlmServer); the tag-only `integration` job is just the llm provider
  smoke and `publish` waits on it. Issue #1267 N1 adds the
  `flutter-app-exzone` leg: it runs the macOS exclusion-zone family

  `native_test_guard.dart`, plus `flutter_app/lib/apps/` + `lib/src/js_ext/`
  are the code that surfaces there) on macos pre-merge, closing the
  nightly-only gap the #1309 escape rode. Under this repo's dispatch-only
  CI the leg is path-blind: ci.yml has no `pull_request` trigger (SM
  `workflow_dispatch` validation is the PR gate), so the leg runs in every
  SM validation dispatch (gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom); the
  `flutter_app/lib/apps/**`/`lib/src/js_ext/**`/`flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`
  path set in the `changes` job only narrows a future real `pull_request`
  trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — `nightly.yml` keeps
  the full-suite macOS backstop there. `nightly.yml` runs the full monolith +
  PTY/CLI integration (full real-provider suite with secrets) +
  terminal-visual suites; `coverage-gardener.yml` measures the only-up CLI
  coverage weekly and files an ai-teammate "raise coverage to X" issue —
  the baseline itself only moves through a reviewed PR (issue #927).

{"newText":"  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after. gh-1537: extracted from ci.yml (no main-push trigger
  # there anymore) and dropped the needs: quality-gate — the bump commit's
  # full-gate validation moved to the cut v* tag run, which gates
  # publish/binaries (see the file header).
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')","oldText":"  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after.
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

{"newText":"## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

{"newText":"The scheme: `scripts/auto_release.sh` patch-bumps

release-only workflow; its job starts only on the `chore(release):` bump
commit and runs no validation gates — the enforce-lockfile smoke stays
the pre-tag gate, and the full quality gate runs on the cut tag BEFORE
publish/binaries), and the tag drives the `publish`/`binaries` jobs of
ci.yml's `v*` arm. Manual `workflow_dispatch` runs are input-gated:
`releaseDryRun: true` exercises the whole pipeline without the push/tag

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

{"newText":"## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's

published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's

serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

{"newText":"## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

{"newText":"## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

{"newText":"The scheme: `scripts/auto_release.sh` patch-bumps
`pubspec.yaml` and pushes the bump commit straight to protected `main` as the
fa-release-bot GitHub App (the ruleset's only bypass actor, gh-1172 — the
2026-09-29 release-PR stopgap is retired); the push fires
`release-tag.yml` (extracted from ci.yml by gh-1537 — ci.yml no longer
triggers on main pushes, so the tag-on-bump phase rides its own minimal
release-only workflow; its job starts only on the `chore(release):` bump
commit and runs no validation gates — the enforce-lockfile smoke stays
the pre-tag gate, and the full quality gate runs on the cut tag BEFORE
publish/binaries), and the tag drives the `publish`/`binaries` jobs of
ci.yml's `v*` arm. Manual `workflow_dispatch` runs are input-gated:

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

{"newText":"## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's

(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

{"newText":"## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The

# gh-1537 — the tag-on-bump phase of the release chain, extracted from
# ci.yml. It needs a push-to-main trigger, and ci.yml no longer has one:
# the post-merge main CI run is retired (the SM's pre-merge validation
# dispatch is the single CI gate). THIS FILE IS RELEASE FLOW, NOT CI —
# it runs no validation gates:
#   - the only push that starts the job is the fa-release-bot App's
#     'chore(release):' bump commit (gh-1172 direct push to protected
#     main) — SM merge commits (squash subjects `KEY summary (#PR)`)
#     evaluate the job `if` to false and skip in milliseconds,
#   - the enforce-lockfile smoke stays the pre-tag gate (gh-1299 NG2/AC3,
#     pinned by release_hygiene_test.dart — inside tag_release.sh),
#   - the FULL quality gate runs on the cut v* tag (ci.yml's tags arm)
#     BEFORE publish/binaries — the bump commit's validation moved there.
# Serialized with the ci.yml bump job via the release-main group: tag
# first, next bump after. (#1522 will retire the bump flow itself once
# tag-sourced versions land — this workflow goes with it.)
name: Release tag

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after. gh-1537: extracted from ci.yml (no main-push trigger
  # there anymore) and dropped the needs: quality-gate — the bump commit's
  # full-gate validation moved to the cut v* tag run, which gates
  # publish/binaries (see the file header).
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
        run: bash scripts/tag_release.sh

# gh-1537 — the tag-on-bump phase of the release chain, extracted from

blocks.text:
# gh-1537 — the tag-on-bump phase of the release chain, extracted from
# ci.yml. It needs a push-to-main trigger, and ci.yml no longer has one:
# the post-merge main CI run is retired (the SM's pre-merge validation
# dispatch is the single CI gate). THIS FILE IS RELEASE FLOW, NOT CI —
# it runs no validation gates:
#   - the only push that starts the job is the fa-release-bot App's
#     'chore(release):' bump commit (gh-1172 direct push to protected
#     main) — SM merge commits (squash subjects `KEY summary (#PR)`)
#     evaluate the job `if` to false and skip in milliseconds,
#   - the enforce-lockfile smoke stays the pre-tag gate (gh-1299 NG2/AC3,
#     pinned by release_hygiene_test.dart — inside tag_release.sh),
#   - the FULL quality gate runs on the cut v* tag (ci.yml's tags arm)
#     BEFORE publish/binaries — the bump commit's validation moved there.
# Serialized with the ci.yml bump job via the release-main group: tag
# first, next bump after. (#1522 will retire the bump flow itself once
# tag-sourced versions land — this workflow goes with it.)
name: Release tag

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after. gh-1537: extracted from ci.yml (no main-push trigger
  # there anymore) and dropped the needs: quality-gate — the bump commit's
  # full-gate validation moved to the cut v* tag run, which gates
  # publish/binaries (see the file header).
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
        run: bash scripts/tag_release.sh

blocks.text:
# gh-1537 — the tag-on-bump phase of the release chain, extracted from
# ci.yml. It needs a push-to-main trigger, and ci.yml no longer has one:
# the post-merge main CI run is retired (the SM's pre-merge validation
# dispatch is the single CI gate). THIS FILE IS RELEASE FLOW, NOT CI —
# it runs no validation gates:
#   - the only push that starts the job is the fa-release-bot App's
#     'chore(release):' bump commit (gh-1172 direct push to protected
#     main) — SM merge commits (squash subjects `KEY summary (#PR)`)
#     evaluate the job `if` to false and skip in milliseconds,
#   - the enforce-lockfile smoke stays the pre-tag gate (gh-1299 NG2/AC3,
#     pinned by release_hygiene_test.dart — inside tag_release.sh),
#   - the FULL quality gate runs on the cut v* tag (ci.yml's tags arm)
#     BEFORE publish/binaries — the bump commit's validation moved there.
# Serialized with the ci.yml bump job via the release-main group: tag
# first, next bump after. (#1522 will retire the bump flow itself once
# tag-sourced versions land — this workflow goes with it.)
name: Release tag

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after. gh-1537: extracted from ci.yml (no main-push trigger
  # there anymore) and dropped the needs: quality-gate — the bump commit's
  # full-gate validation moved to the cut v* tag run, which gates
  # publish/binaries (see the file header).
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
        run: bash scripts/tag_release.sh

release-tag.yml looks good. One consideration: since the job no longer needs quality-gate, tag_release.sh requires BUMP_SHA — provided via push event. Good.
