blocks.text:
# gh-1537 — the tag-on-bump phase of the release chain, extracted from
# ci.yml. It needs a push-to-main trigger, and ci.yml no longer has one:
# the post-merge main CI run is retired (the SM's pre-merge validation
# dispatch is the single CI gate). THIS FILE IS RELEASE FLOW, NOT CI —
# it runs no validation gates:
#   - the only push that starts the job is the fa-release-bot App's
#     'chore(release):' bump commit (gh-1172 direct push to protected
#     main) — SM merge commits (squash subjects `KEY summary (#PR)`)
#     evaluate the job `if` to false and skip in milliseconds,
#   - the enforce-lockfile smoke stays the pre-tag gate (gh-1299 NG2/AC3,
#     pinned by release_hygiene_test.dart — inside tag_release.sh),
#   - the FULL quality gate runs on the cut v* tag (ci.yml's tags arm)
#     BEFORE publish/binaries — the bump commit's validation moved there.
# Serialized with the ci.yml bump job via the release-main group: tag
# first, next bump after. (#1522 will retire the bump flow itself once
# tag-sourced versions land — this workflow goes with it.)
name: Release tag

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after. gh-1537: extracted from ci.yml (no main-push trigger
  # there anymore) and dropped the needs: quality-gate — the bump commit's
  # full-gate validation moved to the cut v* tag run, which gates
  # publish/binaries (see the file header).
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
        run: bash scripts/tag_release.sh

# gh-1537 — the tag-on-bump phase of the release chain, extracted from
# ci.yml. It needs a push-to-main trigger, and ci.yml no longer has one:
# the post-merge main CI run is retired (the SM's pre-me…

blocks.text:
# gh-1537 — the tag-on-bump phase of the release chain, extracted from
# ci.yml. It needs a push-to-main trigger, and ci.yml no longer has one:
# the post-merge main CI run is retired (the SM's pre-merge validation
# dispatch is the single CI gate). THIS FILE IS RELEASE FLOW, NOT CI —
# it runs no validation gates:
#   - the only push that starts the job is the fa-release-bot App's
#     'chore(release):' bump commit (gh-1172 direct push to protected
#     main) — SM merge commits (squash subjects `KEY summary (#PR)`)
#     evaluate the job `if` to false and skip in milliseconds,
#   - the enforce-lockfile smoke stays the pre-tag gate (gh-1299 NG2/AC3,
#     pinned by release_hygiene_test.dart — inside tag_release.sh),
#   - the FULL quality gate runs on the cut v* tag (ci.yml's tags arm)
#     BEFORE publish/binaries — the bump commit's validation moved there.
# Serialized with the ci.yml bump job via the release-main group: tag
# first, next bump after. (#1522 will retire the bump flow itself once
# tag-sourced versions land — this workflow goes with it.)
name: Release tag

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after. gh-1537: extracted from ci.yml (no main-push trigger
  # there anymore) and dropped the needs: quality-gate — the bump commit's
  # full-gate validation moved to the cut v* tag run, which gates
  # publish/binaries (see the file header).
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}

# gh-1537: Retire post-merge main CI — everything gates in the SM pre-merge run

### What changed
- `ci.yml`: dropped `push: branches: [main]` (keeps `tags: v*` + `workflow_dispatch` + the 2h release-coalesce schedule + `release:`). Verified no gate leg keys off push events: the SM validation dispatch runs the whole-tree gates (crap4dart baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd, app-crap-gate — all full-gate on non-PR events), pinned by a new gate-closure assertion.
- `release-tag` (tag-on-bump) extracted from ci.yml into `release-tag.yml` — it needs a main-push trigger, which ci.yml no longer has; it's release flow, not CI (job fires only on the `chore(release):` bump commit, SM merges skip in ms; the bump's full-gate validation moved to the cut v* tag run, which still gates publish/binaries; the enforce-lockfile smoke stays the pre-tag gate).
- `release` (bump push) job: dead push arm removed — releases arm on schedule + the two input-gated dispatch arms.
- Flake intake: `flake_watch.py` now filters ci.yml failures to `workflow_dispatch` events (PR-dispatch runs; red tag runs are release-flow failures, triaged by daily-publish/ci-red-report), dedup per test name as before.
- New `sm-merge-guard.yml` + `scripts/sm_merge_guard.py` (AC5): every main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched validation — tree-identity match (fast-forward SHA or squash/merge tree), `chore(release):` bumps skipped; violations file one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue. No nightly backstop.
- Docs: AGENTS.md quality-gates section + docs/ci.md describe the single pre-merge gate and the #1522 interaction (fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn).

### Key decisions
- **Gate closure test** (`test/ci_main_push_retired_test.dart`): asserts no job in the quality-gate/binaries-smoke-gate needs-closure keys on push events — the release legs (publish, provider smoke, ci-red-report) intentionally key on tag pushes and are outside the closure.
- **Tag extraction over re-triggering**: moving `release-tag` keeps the release chain working until #1522 retires the bump flow; the App-token wiring, BUMP_SHA pin and enforce-lockfile smoke moved verbatim (existing pins updated, not dropped).
- **Tree sha, not commit sha** in the merge guard: the SM may land fast-forward or squash — the invariant is byte-identical trees.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_main_push_retired_test.dart test/scripts/sm_merge_guard_test.dart \
  test/release_hygiene_test.dart test/release_flow_race_test.dart \
  test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  SM[Machine SM serialized queue] -->|update onto main + dispatch ci.yml on head| VAL[Full gate run]
  VAL -->|green| MERGE[Merge: tree lands byte-identical]
  MERGE -->|push main| GUARD[sm-merge-guard.yml]
  GUARD -->|tree covered by a successful dispatch| OK[green]
  GUARD -->|no coverage| ALARM[sm-guard issue]
  BUMP[release job: schedule/dispatch arms] -->|chore(release) push| TAG[release-tag.yml cuts v* tag]
  TAG -->|tag push| TGTRUN[ci.yml v* arm: full gate -> publish/binaries]
```

</details>

# gh-1537 — the tag-on-bump phase of the release chain, extracted from
# ci.yml. It needs a push-to-main trigger, and ci.yml no longer has one:
# the post-merge main CI run is retired (the SM's pre-me…

blocks.text:
# gh-1537 — the tag-on-bump phase of the release chain, extracted from
# ci.yml. It needs a push-to-main trigger, and ci.yml no longer has one:
# the post-merge main CI run is retired (the SM's pre-merge validation
# dispatch is the single CI gate). THIS FILE IS RELEASE FLOW, NOT CI —
# it runs no validation gates:
#   - the only push that starts the job is the fa-release-bot App's
#     'chore(release):' bump commit (gh-1172 direct push to protected
#     main) — SM merge commits (squash subjects `KEY summary (#PR)`)
#     evaluate the job `if` to false and skip in milliseconds,
#   - the enforce-lockfile smoke stays the pre-tag gate (gh-1299 NG2/AC3,
#     pinned by release_hygiene_test.dart — inside tag_release.sh),
#   - the FULL quality gate runs on the cut v* tag (ci.yml's tags arm)
#     BEFORE publish/binaries — the bump commit's validation moved there.
# Serialized with the ci.yml bump job via the release-main group: tag
# first, next bump after. (#1522 will retire the bump flow itself once
# tag-sourced versions land — this workflow goes with it.)
name: Release tag

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after. gh-1537: extracted from ci.yml (no main-push trigger
  # there anymore) and dropped the needs: quality-gate — the bump commit's
  # full-gate validation moved to the cut v* tag run, which gates
  # publish/binaries (see the file header).
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.

{"content":"# gh-1537: Retire post-merge main CI — everything gates in the SM pre-merge run

### What changed
- `ci.yml`: dropped `push: branches: [main]` (keeps `tags: v*` + `workflow_dispatch` + the 2h release-coalesce schedule + `release:`). Verified no gate leg keys off push events: the SM validation dispatch runs the whole-tree gates (crap4dart baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd, app-crap-gate — all full-gate on non-PR events), pinned by a new gate-closure assertion.
- `release-tag` (tag-on-bump) extracted from ci.yml into `release-tag.yml` — it needs a main-push trigger, which ci.yml no longer has; it's release flow, not CI (job fires only on the `chore(release):` bump commit, SM merges skip in ms; the bump's full-gate validation moved to the cut v* tag run, which still gates publish/binaries; the enforce-lockfile smoke stays the pre-tag gate).
- `release` (bump push) job: dead push arm removed — releases arm on schedule + the two input-gated dispatch arms.
- Flake intake: `flake_watch.py` now filters ci.yml failures to `workflow_dispatch` events (PR-dispatch runs; red tag runs are release-flow failures, triaged by daily-publish/ci-red-report), dedup per test name as before.
- New `sm-merge-guard.yml` + `scripts/sm_merge_guard.py` (AC5): every main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched validation — tree-identity match (fast-forward SHA or squash/merge tree), `chore(release):` bumps skipped; violations file one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue. No nightly backstop.
- Docs: AGENTS.md quality-gates section + docs/ci.md describe the single pre-merge gate and the #1522 interaction (fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn).

### Key decisions
- **Gate closure test** (`test/ci_main_push_retired_test.dart`): asserts no job in the quality-gate/binaries-smoke-gate needs-closure keys on push events — the release legs (publish, provider smoke, ci-red-report) intentionally key on tag pushes and are outside the closure.
- **Tag extraction over re-triggering**: moving `release-tag` keeps the release chain working until #1522 retires the bump flow; the App-token wiring, BUMP_SHA pin and enforce-lockfile smoke moved verbatim (existing pins updated, not dropped).
- **Tree sha, not commit sha** in the merge guard: the SM may land fast-forward or squash — the invariant is byte-identical trees.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_main_push_retired_test.dart test/scripts/sm_merge_guard_test.dart \
  test/release_hygiene_test.dart test/release_flow_race_test.dart \
  test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  SM[Machine SM serialized queue] -->|update onto main + dispatch ci.yml on head| VAL[Full gate run]

  GUARD -->|tree covered by a successful dispatch| OK[green]

  BUMP[release job: schedule/dispatch arms] -->|chore(release) push| TAG[release-tag.yml cuts v* tag]
  TAG -->|tag push| TGTRUN[ci.yml v* arm: full gate -> publish/binaries]
```

blocks.text:
# gh-1537 — the tag-on-bump phase of the release chain, extracted from
# ci.yml. It needs a push-to-main trigger, and ci.yml no longer has one:
# the post-merge main CI run is retired (the SM's pre-merge validation
# dispatch is the single CI gate). THIS FILE IS RELEASE FLOW, NOT CI —
# it runs no validation gates:
#   - the only push that starts the job is the fa-release-bot App's
#     'chore(release):' bump commit (gh-1172 direct push to protected
#     main) — SM merge commits (squash subjects `KEY summary (#PR)`)
#     evaluate the job `if` to false and skip in milliseconds,
#   - the enforce-lockfile smoke stays the pre-tag gate (gh-1299 NG2/AC3,
#     pinned by release_hygiene_test.dart — inside tag_release.sh),
#   - the FULL quality gate runs on the cut v* tag (ci.yml's tags arm)
#     BEFORE publish/binaries — the bump commit's validation moved there.
# Serialized with the ci.yml bump job via the release-main group: tag
# first, next bump after. (#1522 will retire the bump flow itself once
# tag-sourced versions land — this workflow goes with it.)
name: Release tag

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release from the pushed 'chore(release):'
  # bump commit (see scripts/tag_release.sh). The bump lands via direct push
  # to protected main as the fa-release-bot App (gh-1172), so the tag phase
  # keys on that push. Tag push rides the App token (checkout token) —
  # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs.
  # Serialized with the bump push job via the release-main group: tag first,
  # next bump after. gh-1537: extracted from ci.yml (no main-push trigger
  # there anymore) and dropped the needs: quality-gate — the bump commit's
  # full-gate validation moved to the cut v* tag run, which gates
  # publish/binaries (see the file header).
  release-tag:
    name: Auto-release (tag on push)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      # Same fa-release-bot App as the bump job (gh-1172): the tag push and
      # `gh release create` ride the App installation token — without an
      # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in tag_release.sh was a
      # guaranteed silent no-op and the curated CHANGELOG notes never reached
      # the release object (BLOCK finding on PR #1093, live review 2026-09-30).
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write only —
          # the tag push + `gh release create` need nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token so the pushed tag triggers the publish job —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # gh-1299 NG2/AC3: the tag step smokes `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
      # on the bump commit BEFORE tagging/publishing (a release commit that
      # cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published) —
      # the gate needs flutter on PATH, pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming build legs use (PR #1304 rework thread 8).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 1): warm the pub cache with the shared
      # bounded-retry action so tag_release.sh's own enforce-lockfile smoke
      # rides it — the smoke stays in the script (release_hygiene NG2/AC3
      # pins it) but is no longer the job's first resolution, so one
      # transient git-dep clone reset cannot abort the pre-tag gate on a
      # cold cache (the v1.0.516 build-macos exit-69 class, on the release
      # path).
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Cut annotated tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # gh-1192 AC3: pin the tag to the bump commit the push event
          # carried. head_commit.id is frozen at event time; a default
          # checkout can land on a main that moved in the seconds between the
          # bump push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178
          # interloper that way). tag_release.sh validates the sha (exact
          # bump subject + matching pubspec version) before tagging and
          # refuses to tag a moving HEAD when nothing qualifies.
          BUMP_SHA: ${{ github.event.head_commit.id || github.sha }}
        run: bash scripts/tag_release.sh

release-tag.yml looks good. One consideration: since the job no longer needs quality-gate, tag_release.sh requires BUMP_SHA — provided via push event. Good.
